sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:20

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:20:1
items.html:
To the Sitra Achra they give a greater number, yet in its counting it is in deficiency, such as Ashtei Asar [eleven]: From here he brings a proof for his words above, where he says that the whole of the ABYA of the shells is eleven Sefirot, standing opposite the whole of the ABYA of holiness, which is ten Sefirot. And he explains the reason why they are eleven in number: because they are from the remnant of the dross that was not sorted, as above, and in this matter there are eleven — the seven kings and four posteriors, of AVI and of YESHSUT, which are eleven. In the secret of the verse, “Where are their gods, the rock in whom they took refuge.” And understand. And they are the secret of the “eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir,” and they are the secret of the eleven spices of the incense. And since they are all the vitality that is in the shells, therefore when they are offered up as incense, the vitality of the shells rises upward, and the dross and death are annulled, and the plague is halted.
Indeed the ARI did not come here to explain the words of the Zohar in their own right; and since there is a very great secret in their words, it is fitting to bring the passage in full and to explain it a little. And these are his words: “To the Sitra Achra they give a greater number, yet in its counting it is in deficiency, such as Ashtei Asar. And behold they established that in every place where letters are added in this manner, it is to its detriment, such as ‘Aminon your brother,’ where Amnon suffices; while on the side of holiness a letter is subtracted and it is an addition.” End of quote. The explanation: the whole of the Sitra Achra is from the breaking of the vessels, as above in the words of the ARI, where there are eleven; and it is known that their correction is in the secret of the twelve Partzufim of holiness, for the whole correction of the breaking of the vessels is in the secret of the twelve Partzufim of Atzilut, through which the Sitra Achra goes on being annulled until “He will swallow up death forever.”
And this is what he says, “To the Sitra Achra they give a greater number, yet in its counting it is in deficiency”: for “number” is an appellation for Malchut, and the Malchut of the Sitra Achra is in the aspect of a greater number. (Note in the author’s own hand: “Hushbena” means Hochma, and “Yatir” means one who adds, in the secret of “whoever adds, detracts.”) This is the secret of “kingship without a crown,” for they are nine and not ten, since they have no nursing whatsoever from Keter — and “Taga” means Keter. Therefore they are in insolence, in the aspect of kingship without a crown. And they are an evil Ayin [ע], in the secret of “ninety-nine die of an evil eye and one of all other illnesses.” And this is what he says, “such as Ashtei Asar”: that is, in the secret of “whoever adds, detracts,” they add the Ayin to Shtei Asar. (Note in the author’s own hand: and the upper Partzuf of the twelve departs, which is the secret of Ein Sof and Keter.) And they remained with only eleven. (Note in the author’s own hand: that is, eleven, for they are annulled and broken and descend into the domain of the shells; and this is the secret of the tree that cried out, “Wicked one, do not touch it!” — for at the touch of an eye upon Shtei Asar the light departs, and the combination Ashtei Asar that is thereby made falls to the shells.) For they have no nursing in Keter. And this is what he says, “on the side of holiness a letter is subtracted and it is an addition”: that is, they subtract the Ayin from Ashtei Asar, and the combination of holiness comes out, with an addition, for it becomes Shtei Asar. And understand this together with the words of the ARI and with the continuation of the words of the Zohar there.
